relations.subject: Robert Maclagan
relations.evidence: He was educated at the High School in Edinburgh and the University of Edinburgh but did not graduate.

relations.subject: Robert Maclagan
relations.evidence: He then went to Addiscombe Military Seminary near London.

relations.subject: Robert Maclagan
relations.object: School of Military Engineering in Chatham
relations.evidence: He then went to the School of Military Engineering in Chatham, to specialise as an engineer.

relations.subject: Robert Maclagan
relations.evidence: Following severe illness he was given more sedate duties, including running the Civil Engineering College at Rurki aged 27.

relations.subject: Robert Maclagan
relations.evidence: and a daughter, Mary, who in 1892 married Charles Oman, an Oxford historian.
